integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a Steadicam shot trails closely behind a woman sprinting down a shattered avenue in a disorderly, ruined city, lit with raw, harsh cinematic illumination — hard shafts of light cutting through dust — in heavily desaturated, almost monochrome colors. The Steadicam keeps a relentless forward trailing motion with subtle handheld-style sway as the woman, her voice raw and urgent (S1), chants lyrics between ragged breaths: <d>[English] Run — the sky is falling down!</d> Terrified bystanders scatter to the sides, diving into doorways and behind abandoned cars as she weaves past them with her stride. Above, cracked high-rises groan; chunks of rubble cascade down the facades and crash onto the pavement, kicking up dust around her feet. Thick drifting haze rolls through the street, billowing in slow motion around her body as she pushes deeper into the chaos, and in the final seconds the haze momentarily swallows her silhouette as she sprints on.

overall_soundscape: Heavy footfalls pound the cracked pavement alongside the woman's ragged panting, while bystanders shout and stumble over debris. Rubble crashes onto the street with sharp impacts, dust hisses outward, and the cracked high-rises emit low structural groans beneath a wind-driven ambience.
